svg.title: Compression can be followed by selecting only some summaries
svg.desc: A groups past positions 0–15 in pairs into b0–b7. Orange outlines select b1,b5 as the top two; local originals 14,15,16 are also read. B groups the same 16 positions in fours into c0–c3 and reads all four summaries with the same local originals 14,15,16.
